label: heldout-3090
_hypothesis: The agent memorises the single map instead of learning that a ramp can be surfed. Train ONE policy on 8 pool maps, evaluate at every eval on 2 maps it never trains on (--heldout-maps). A policy that learned surfing makes progress on the unseen maps; a map-memoriser does not. Verdict columns: race/heldout_pct_field.<tag> and race/heldout_progress_field.<tag> (+ race/heldout_finishes.<tag>) for tags prechasm and hollow_lite, read at MATCHED STEPS across arms and against each arm's own iteration-1 (untrained) reading; race/map_pct (training maps) beside them so 'learned the training maps, nothing transferred' is distinguishable from 'learned nothing'. One seed per arm; the 27% noise floor applies.
_maps: TRAINING (8, all type-1 trigger finishes = strong evidence, verify=pass, no warnings, fields gated coarse_ok at cell 48, routes 14.9k-36.5k u; mmPOOL 34B-step per-map cover in parens): surf_dedicated 14,877u (10.6%), surf_fallway 27,805u (4.6%), surf_unitfarmer2 30,589u (5.1%), surf_latebra 33,763u (5.6%), surf_lowestbidder 34,480u (18.5%), surf_petrus_lite 35,956u (18.9%), surf_secret_passage 36,230u (7.4%), surf_arcs 36,471u (8.9%). HELD-OUT (2, same criteria, picked as the two most LEARNABLE trigger maps of the pool so the held-out metric has room to move): surf_prechasm 12,905u (20.9%, the highest of any trigger map), surf_hollow_lite 24,360u (15.4%). Excluded on purpose: cannonball (198k u, 654M-voxel SDF, needs ep_ticks 12000), button-finish maps (weak evidence, the sim cannot press a button), the degenerate four (bucetation/shortbox/ut0pia/desert_city), family duplicates (unitfarmer1 vs unitfarmer2).
env: MULTIMAP=1 MAPS=maps/surf_arcs.bsp,maps/surf_dedicated.bsp,maps/surf_fallway.bsp,maps/surf_latebra.bsp,maps/surf_lowestbidder.bsp,maps/surf_petrus_lite.bsp,maps/surf_secret_passage.bsp,maps/surf_unitfarmer2.bsp GOAL_CELLS=48,48,48,48,48,48,48,48 HELDOUT_MAPS=maps/surf_hollow_lite.bsp,maps/surf_prechasm.bsp HELDOUT_CELLS=48,48 ENVS=8192 BUDGET_MM=2.5e9 RECORD_EVERY_MM=300e6 EVAL_EPS_MM=3
_env_notes: MULTIMAP=1 = the run_arm.sh MULTIMAP branch on ONE GPU (single process, no torchrun; its argument set: --reward race, 64x32 depth, --lidar-cell 32, --act-every 4, --n-steps 32, --ep-ticks 6000, --respawn-frac 0.9, --int-coef 0.25, --eval-greedy-only, NO --obs-reward). ENVS=8192 = 1024 envs per map slot; with --n-steps 32 that is the same 262,144-row rollout buffer and 16,384-row minibatch the wave-2 DEEP arms ran on 24 GB cards (xW2DEEP3 on a 3090), so the DEEP net fits. BUDGET_MM=2.5e9 is above what 4 h on a 3090 delivers (~0.5-0.6e9/h with the deep net incl. evals) so the on-box deadline ends the run. RECORD_EVERY_MM=300e6 + EVAL_EPS_MM=3 = ~7 evals of 10 maps x 3 greedy episodes, ~5-7 min each with --eval-stall 1 (~17% of the wall clock; the held-out metric IS the experiment); the eval at iteration 1 is kept on purpose - it is every arm's untrained zero-point on the held-out maps. Use EVAL_EPS_MM=1 to halve the eval cost.
_base_notes: Appended after the MULTIMAP branch's own flags, so --respawn-margin 2 overrides the branch's pinned 10 (argparse last-wins). Plain geodesic race reward: no --goals, no --race-arc, no --route (all refused with --heldout-maps anyway).

caches._note: Every file lives in C:/RL_Surf/maps_pool/ and must land in /root/RL_Surf/maps/ on the box (flat layout: MAPS= above is maps/<stem>.bsp). Sizes in KB. After the copy run `python3 tools/restamp_maps.py && python3 tools/restamp_maps.py --check` ON THE BOX: scp does not preserve mtimes and every cache keys on the bsp's mtime_ns, so without the restamp all 10 goal fields + SDFs silently rebake on rented time. Total 57.3 MB over 10 maps (box_finish.sh today ships only cannonball's 4 caches, ~57 MB, which this wave does not need at all).
caches._xH1NRM_extra: --normals 1 additionally needs, PER MAP (all 10), viewer/assets/<stem>.mesh.json (tools/export_map.py) and maps/<stem>.surfn_32.npz (surfgym.surfmask.build_surfnormal, keyed on the bsp sig + the mesh's content hash). Neither is in the pool bundle. Without the mesh the NRM arm CRASHES at startup (FileNotFoundError from build_surfnormal); with the mesh but no surfn cache it bakes on the box (0.3-3.6 s per map on CPU). Pre-baked locally 2026-09-04 into C:/Users/bulti/AppData/Local/Temp/claude/C--RL-Surf/e56a2b21-7ab5-4fab-a437-f0bf1163e752/scratchpad/nrmbake/nrm_caches/ (10 x .mesh.json = 0.3-5.0 MB each, 10 x .surfn_32.npz = 60-317 KB each, 21.4 MB total): copy the .mesh.json files to viewer/assets/ and the .surfn_32.npz files to maps/ on the NRM box, or re-run tools/export_map.py + the bake there.

launcher._status: NOT reachable with tools/wave/wave_launch.py + box_finish.sh as they are: box_finish.sh hard-codes `SCRATCH=1 BUDGET=40000000000 RECORD_EVERY=75e6 EVAL_EPS=9 bash tools/run_arm.sh $RUN $*` (the single-map SCRATCH branch, cannonball) and ships only cannonball's four caches. The MULTIMAP branch is selected by environment (MULTIMAP=... MAPS=... GOAL_CELLS=... HELDOUT_MAPS=... HELDOUT_CELLS=...), which the launcher has no way to pass. Three edits, all outside this task's file scope:
launcher.wave_launch.py#1: in main(), next to the BASE expansion: arm["env"] = (wave.get("env", "") + " " + arm.get("env", "")).strip()
launcher.wave_launch.py#2: in deploy_and_launch(), the box_finish.sh subprocess.run: env=dict(ENV, ARM_ENV=arm.get("env", ""), POOL_MAPS=arm.get("pool_maps", "")) - and set arm["pool_maps"] in main() from wave["pool_maps"] (below)

Optionally raise the liveness window: the MULTIMAP branch already waits 300 s and the iteration-1 eval of 10 maps can take ~5 min before the first `step` line, but the branch only fails on a DEAD pid, so no change is required.

pool_maps: surf_arcs surf_dedicated surf_fallway surf_latebra surf_lowestbidder surf_petrus_lite surf_secret_passage surf_unitfarmer2 surf_hollow_lite surf_prechasm
_reading: Per arm and per eval the trainer prints a HELD-OUT table (cover % of own start distance | box finishes / eps | field progress) under the MAP TABLE, and progress.csv carries race/heldout_progress_field.{prechasm,hollow_lite}, race/heldout_finish_s.*, race/heldout_finishes.*, race/heldout_pct_field.* as the LAST columns. Held-out trajectories are traj_<step>_prechasm.jsonl / traj_<step>_hollow_lite.jsonl next to the training maps' traj_<step>_<tag>.jsonl. Neither held-out map has a route line, so there is no corridor MAX column; the field metric on a 13-24k u map with a trigger finish is far less exposed to the cannonball death-dive than eval_progress on cannonball, but check the trajectories' end z against the zones.json end box before calling a finish. tools/record_ckpt.py <ckpt> --map maps/surf_prechasm.bsp reproduces the probe from a harvested checkpoint (it reads heldout_goal_cells / heldout_map_cells from run.json).
